candidate.local-change: small change to the baseline plan
empty: No runs yet. Results appear here automatically once a run starts.
fallbackNote: If the policy finds no admissible plan, the same number of small changes to the baseline plan is checked. All constraints and trust checks still apply.
footnote: Verification uses the plan and conditions saved when this run started. Form changes create a new run.
hashesNote: The first 12 characters are shown; the full value is in the hover hint.
heading: Runs and results
intro: The surrogate searches for a plan under the form conditions. Then verify the plan in OPM: submission needs the full-run NPV and no violations. No file download is required to start.
manifestMissing: The run manifest is not recorded yet.
noImprovement: No improvement over the baseline plan was found among the admissible candidates checked.
noticeFallback: The plan came from the fallback search around the baseline plan, not from the agent policy.
noticeTail: This is not an error: the result came from an admissible fallback method, and the same condition checks were applied. Keep it in mind when comparing with main-search runs.
noticeUnclaimed: Agent policy convergence is not claimed for this plan.
reloadConditions: Load these conditions back into the form
start: Find a plan with the surrogate
strategy.baseline-neighborhood: fallback search around the baseline plan
submissionBuiltNoSchedule: The bundle is built, but the schedule file is missing.
submissionMissing: The submission bundle is not built. The claimed NPV and bundle hashes appear once it is built.
unavailable: The compute server is unavailable. The form still works for preparing conditions.
unseenNoOverlap: This plan has no exact match among the {count} training schedules.
unseenNote: A small error on total NPV does not guarantee an accurate estimate of a small gain or loss. OPM confirmation covers the chosen plan meeting the conditions, not its optimality.
unseenPaired: NPV change against the previous verified plan: forecast {predicted}, OPM {measured}.
unsound: The plan failed the full check. Its NPV cannot be claimed as confirmed.
violations: Blocking violations: {blocking}. Diagnostic findings in total: {total}. Failed control identities: {identities}.
